# processes

The executable half of this layer's methodologies: `diig-investment-path.bpmn` renders DIIG's nine chapters as a process with its two progress checks as gateways. Declared separately from `methodologies/` because a directory entry names one graph typology: the prose says what the method is, the diagram how it runs.
